note: Trigger-accuracy regression suite. Same shape and run command as ../../recording-decisions/evals/README.md. The skill is meant to be preloaded into reviewer agents; these prompts cover the cases where a session has to pick it up itself.

evals.name: reviewer-with-a-base
evals.prompt: you're the security reviewer for this PR. the branch has a .strauss/kb — read what's on the hunks first and write back what you find.
evals.why: A reviewer, a companion base, and a write-back ask.

evals.name: check-the-claims
evals.prompt: the companion base on this branch claims a mitigation exists in PaymentClient.charge. can you check the claims in .strauss/kb against what the diff actually does?
evals.why: Checking base claims against code is the check table.

evals.name: does-the-record-lie
evals.prompt: decision.tenant-cache-ttl says the cache is invalidated on write. read the anchor and tell me if that's true, and do the same for every other record on this diff.
evals.why: Per-record anchor reading across a diff.

evals.name: what-do-i-write-as-reviewer
evals.prompt: i found a risk the author didn't record while reviewing perf. how do i put it in the kb without it looking like the author wrote it?
evals.why: The write table and the actor rule.

evals.name: reviewer-report-block
evals.prompt: finishing my review of main..HEAD — what's the kb block i'm supposed to end with, and what goes in partial?

evals.name: plain-review-no-base
evals.prompt: review this diff for bugs. there's no .strauss directory in this repo.
evals.why: No companion base: a plain review.

evals.name: author-writing-records
evals.prompt: i'm implementing the retry change — which risks and decisions should i record in .strauss/kb as i go?

evals.name: merge-decision
evals.prompt: given the reviewer's kb block, does this PR merge on its own or does it need a human?

evals.name: broken-base
evals.prompt: strauss-kb validate fails on this branch with two broken links. fix the base so the reviewers can run.
